name: energyflowx
description: Engineering calculations for fluids, air and pipework: validated thermophysical properties for 29 fluids from reference equations of state, HVAC process chains, pipe and duct sizing against real product catalogues, and full hydraulic network solving for liquids, gases and steam, with pumps, compressors with heat recovery, heat exchangers, storage tanks and receivers, in steady state or over time. Connects the EnergyFlowX members MCP server, every tool behind one sign-in, and adds the method for using them well.

interface.shortDescription: Fluid properties, HVAC processes, pipe sizing and hydraulic networks
interface.longDescription: Engineering calculations for fluids, air and pipework from the EnergyFlowX engines. Validated thermophysical properties for 29 fluids from reference equations of state, with the method and validity range on every result. Air-handling processes: heating, cooling with condensate, mixing, heat recovery, fans and humidification. Pipe and duct sizing against real product catalogues. Hydraulic network design and solving for liquids, gases and steam, with pumps, compressors, heat exchangers, tanks and receivers, steady or over time, handed over as a study page, a CAD drawing (DXF) and a PDF. Four skills teach the method: which inputs matter, what to check before quoting a number, and how to present a result.
defaultPrompt: What are the density and viscosity of 30% propylene glycol at 5 °C?
Which pipe size for 2 kg/s of water at 70 °C, at most 1.5 m/s?
Heat 5000 m3/h of outdoor air from -10 °C, 80% RH to 20 °C. What heating power?
